home.getstarted.ps3.desc: Install M7 Jellyfin on your PlayStation 3.
home.getstarted.linux.desc: Install M7 Jellyfin on Linux and Raspberry Pi.
install.title: Install on {platform}
install.subtitle: Follow the steps below to get M7 Jellyfin running on {platform}.
install.requirements.ps3: A PlayStation 3 with Movian installed and network access.
install.requirements.linux: A Linux system or Raspberry Pi with Movian installed.
install.requirements.windows: A Windows PC with Movian installed.
install.ps3.name: PS3
install.ps3.step1: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page.
install.ps3.step2: Copy the plugin folder to your Movian plugins directory on the PS3.
install.ps3.step4: Open the plugin and connect to your Jellyfin server.
install.linux.name: Linux
install.linux.summary: Install on Linux and Raspberry Pi.
install.linux.step1: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page.
install.linux.step2: Extract the archive and copy the plugin folder to your Movian plugins directory.
install.linux.step4: Open the plugin and connect to your Jellyfin server.
install.windows.name: Windows
install.windows.step1: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page.
install.windows.step2: Extract the archive and copy the plugin folder to your Movian plugins directory.
install.windows.step4: Open the plugin and connect to your Jellyfin server.
